title: Blomberg — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Blomberg.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "European Precision." Premium tier. Blomberg is Bekos premium compact appliance brand — 24-inch European-sized dishwashers, refrigerators, and laundry at competitive prices. Strong in the condo and compact kitchen segment.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Compact kitchen needs. European-style 24-inch appliance buyers. Condo renovations.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Blomberg:

• 24-inch European sizing perfect for condos and compact kitchens

• Premium compact at competitive pricing

• Beko/Arcelik engineering backing

• Strong in the builder compact segment

• Growing dealer network
